:::{#exm-var-logodds}

#### Variance of an estimated beetle log-odds

For the `beetles` [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression) (`beetles_glm_ungrouped`),
the code below applies @thm-var-logodds at $\vx = (1, 1.8)\'$,
using the estimated covariance matrix of the coefficients in place of $\Sigma$,
and compares the result with the squared standard error from `predict()`:

```{r}
#| label: exm-var-logodds-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_x <- c(1, 1.8)
ex_var_quadratic <- drop(t(ex_x) %*% vcov(beetles_glm_ungrouped) %*% ex_x)
ex_se_predict <- predict(
  beetles_glm_ungrouped,
  newdata = data.frame(dose = 1.8),
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE
)$se.fit
```

The quadratic form gives `r round(ex_var_quadratic, 5)`,
and the squared standard error from `predict()` is `r round(ex_se_predict^2, 5)`,
so the two agree.

:::
